## Description

The Siloam permanent plot lies on the land of the Siloam *tribu*, on uplifted coral limestone in the north of the island of Lifou. The plot was set up in December 2025 at about 60 m elevation. The forest shows no obvious signs of recent disturbance.

The most abundant tree species are *Aglaia elaeagnoidea* (Meliaceae), *Diospyros calciphila* (Ebenaceae) and *Alectryon carinatum* (Sapindaceae), locally known as *sö*, *xetr* and *cangen*, respectively. The largest tree is an *Elaeodendron curtipendulum* (Celastraceae), locally known as *thidraxep*, and the tallest is an *Aglaia elaeagnoidea*, reaching only about 20 m.
